mapper.sql: event_section.id, event_section.event_id, event_section.venue_section_id, event_section.price, event_section.sales_enabled, event_section.created_at, event_section.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO event_sections ( id, event_id, venue_section_id, price, sales_enabled ) SELECT #{id}, e.id, vs.id, #{price}, #{salesEnabled} FROM events e JOIN venue_sections vs ON vs.id = #{venueSectionId} AND vs.venue_id = e.venue_id WHERE e.id = #{eventId} AND e.status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM event_sections event_section JOIN venue_sections venue_section ON venue_section.id = event_section.venue_section_id WHERE event_section.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY venue_section.display_order ASC, venue_section.name ASC, event_section.id ASC
